tasks.description: Design and implement a passwordless authentication system using magic email links. This system should send a one-time login link to the user's email address. The link should sign the user in when clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user requests a login link, then a one-time login link is sent to the user's email address.
Given a valid one-time login link, when the user clicks the link, then the user is signed in.

tasks.description: Design and implement a login form that accepts an email address and has a 'Send login link' button. The form should be accessible and mobile-friendly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user submits the login form, then a one-time login link is sent to the user's email address.
Given an invalid email address, when the user submits the login form, then an error message is displayed.

tasks.description: Implement session token expiration after a period of inactivity. The expiration time should be configurable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user session, when the user is inactive for the configured expiration time, then the session token expires.

tasks.description: Add support for localization to the login form and authentication flow. The system should display the correct language based on the user's locale.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a specific locale, when the user accesses the login form, then the form is displayed in the correct language.

tasks.description: Implement a feature flag to control the rollout of the new authentication system. The flag should be configurable to roll out to a percentage of users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a feature flag configuration, when the flag is enabled, then the new authentication system is used for the configured percentage of users.

tasks.description: Collect metrics on login success rate and time-to-login. The metrics should be stored in a database for analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user login attempt, when the attempt is successful, then the login success rate metric is updated.
Given a user login attempt, when the attempt is successful, then the time-to-login metric is updated.

tasks.description: Remove the password field from the login form, as the system is now passwordless.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login form, when the form is displayed, then the password field is not present.

tasks.description: Remove the 'Forgot password?' link from the login form, as the system is now passwordless.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login form, when the form is displayed, then the 'Forgot password?' link is not present.

tasks.description: Write a plan for rolling out the new authentication system to 10% of users first, then expanding to all users. The plan should include metrics collection and analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Given a rollout plan, when the plan is executed, then the new authentication system is rolled out to 10% of users first, then expanded to all users.
